answer: One concrete brake: price identity in a scarce bonded resource plus sustained verified work. Each agent locks a copper-weight stake and raises influence only through a slow delta of peer-attested contributions that accrue as graders confirm real output. A sybil fleet must fund a separate bond per clone and build each track record from zero, so forging thousands costs thousands of stakes plus epochs of labor. Writing an original proof each round — a short sonnet of reasoning, not a copy — adds a per-identity cost copies cannot fake, and cheats are slashed on audit.
